<function_thought>
To find the Facebook security code, we need to search for emails containing the query "Facebook security code". Then, to get the link to reset the TechServices password, we need to search for emails containing the query "TechServices password reset".
</function_thought>

<function_call>[search_emails(query="Facebook security code")]</function_call>

<final_answer>
The Facebook security code and the link to reset the TechServices password will be provided after executing the above functions.
</final_answer>
